title: Tek bakış

characters.BRO: a boy of about eleven with short black hair, wearing a blue striped sweater
characters.SIS: a girl of about nine with curly brown hair, wearing a pink sweater
characters.MAN: a man of about thirty with short black hair, wearing a navy blue sweater
characters.WOMAN: a woman of about twenty-eight with curly brown hair, wearing a rose pink blouse

scenes.text:
Annen sofrada kızarken kardeşinle göz göze geldiğin
o anı hatırlıyor musun?
scenes.prompt: At a family dinner table in the evening under a warm hanging lamp, {BRO} on the left and {SIS} on the right sit side by side, pressing their lips together and glancing at each other, trying not to laugh.

scenes.text:
Gülmemek için dudağını ısırırdın,
o da tabağına bakardı.
scenes.prompt: At the dinner table under the warm lamp, {SIS} looks down at her plate with puffed cheeks, holding back laughter, rain on the window behind her.
At the dinner table, {BRO} on the left and {SIS} on the right laugh out loud together, heads tilted back, warm lamp light.

scenes.text:
Yıllar geçti ama o bakış
hâlâ kalabalık sofralarda işe yarıyor.
scenes.prompt: At an evening family dinner in a garden under strings of warm lights, {MAN} on the left and {WOMAN} on the right sit across a long table and exchange a knowing glance, holding back smiles, autumn leaves falling.

scenes.text:
Kardeş, tek bakışla anlaştığın tek insandır.
Bunu kardeşine gönder.
scenes.prompt: At sunset, {MAN} and {WOMAN} walk side by side down a garden path under falling golden leaves, laughing hard, seen from the front.

caption:
Kardeşinle bakıştın mı?

Bazı dilleri sadece kardeşler konuşur. 🤍

Bunu kardeşine gönder.
